caption: Castello Aragonese, Ischia
composition: Castle on tidal island with causeway · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: From the shore at dawn the camera looks across the calm sea to the Castello Aragonese on its rocky tidal island. The stone causeway stretches from the lower left to the island's base, while the fortress walls and towers rise on the right, still touched by floodlight. The 06:12 sky glows pink and violet over the water.
